purpose.zh: 练髋内旋的力量和控制
purpose.en: Build strength and control in hip internal rotation.

text.zh: 膝盖不动，小腿和脚向外侧摆开
text.en: Keep your knee still and swing your shin and foot out to the side

text.zh: 坐直，大腿贴椅面，双手放在大腿上
text.en: Sit tall with your thigh on the seat and hands on your thighs.

text.zh: 外侧停一下，再慢慢收回
text.en: Pause at the end, then return slowly.

commonErrors.zh: 膝盖跟着向内或向外移动
commonErrors.en: Letting the knee drift in or out.

cautions.zh: 用轻阻力弹力带，检查固定点牢固；出现疼痛就停止
cautions.en: Use a light band and check the anchor is secure; stop if you feel pain.

cautions.zh: 髋或膝不适时减小幅度
cautions.en: Reduce the range if your hip or knee feels uncomfortable.
